transactions.name: Payment
transactions.doc: This transaction type executes a payment.

transactions.name: EscrowCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates an escrow object.

transactions.name: EscrowFinish
transactions.doc: This transaction type completes an existing escrow.

transactions.name: AccountSet
transactions.doc: This transaction type adjusts various account settings.

transactions.name: EscrowCancel
transactions.doc: This transaction type cancels an existing escrow.

transactions.name: SetRegularKey
transactions.doc: This transaction type sets or clears an account's "regular key".

transactions.name: OfferCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates an offer to trade one asset for another.

transactions.name: OfferCancel
transactions.doc: This transaction type cancels existing offers to trade one asset for another.

transactions.name: TicketCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates a new set of tickets.

transactions.name: SignerListSet
transactions.doc: This transaction type modifies the signer list associated with an account.

transactions.name: PaymentChannelCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates a new unidirectional XRP payment channel.

transactions.name: PaymentChannelFund
transactions.doc: This transaction type funds an existing unidirectional XRP payment channel.

transactions.name: PaymentChannelClaim
transactions.doc: This transaction type submits a claim against an existing unidirectional payment channel.

transactions.name: CheckCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates a new check.

transactions.name: CheckCash
transactions.doc: This transaction type cashes an existing check.

transactions.name: CheckCancel
transactions.doc: This transaction type cancels an existing check.

transactions.name: DepositPreauth
transactions.doc: This transaction type grants or revokes authorization to transfer funds.

transactions.name: TrustSet
transactions.doc: This transaction type modifies a trustline between two accounts.

transactions.name: AccountDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction type deletes an existing account.

transactions.name: NFTokenMint
transactions.doc: This transaction mints a new NFT.

transactions.name: NFTokenBurn
transactions.doc: This transaction burns (i.e. destroys) an existing NFT.

transactions.name: NFTokenCreateOffer
transactions.doc: This transaction creates a new offer to buy or sell an NFT.

transactions.name: NFTokenCancelOffer
transactions.doc: This transaction cancels an existing offer to buy or sell an existing NFT.

transactions.name: NFTokenAcceptOffer
transactions.doc: This transaction accepts an existing offer to buy or sell an existing NFT.

transactions.name: Clawback
transactions.doc: This transaction claws back issued tokens.

transactions.name: AMMClawback
transactions.doc: This transaction claws back tokens from an AMM pool.

transactions.name: AMMCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates an AMM instance

transactions.name: AMMDeposit
transactions.doc: This transaction type deposits into an AMM instance

transactions.name: AMMWithdraw
transactions.doc: This transaction type withdraws from an AMM instance

transactions.name: AMMVote
transactions.doc: This transaction type votes for the trading fee

transactions.name: AMMBid
transactions.doc: This transaction type bids for the auction slot

transactions.name: AMMDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction type deletes AMM in the empty state

transactions.name: XChainCreateClaimID
transactions.doc: This transactions creates a crosschain sequence number

transactions.name: XChainCommit
transactions.doc: This transactions initiates a crosschain transaction

transactions.name: XChainClaim
transactions.doc: This transaction completes a crosschain transaction

transactions.name: XChainAccountCreateCommit
transactions.doc: This transaction initiates a crosschain account create transaction

transactions.name: XChainAddClaimAttestation
transactions.doc: This transaction adds an attestation to a claim

transactions.name: XChainAddAccountCreateAttestation
transactions.doc: This transaction adds an attestation to an account

transactions.name: XChainModifyBridge
transactions.doc: This transaction modifies a sidechain

transactions.name: XChainCreateBridge
transactions.doc: This transactions creates a sidechain

transactions.name: DIDSet
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates or updates a DID

transactions.name: DIDDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction type deletes a DID

transactions.name: OracleSet
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates an Oracle instance

transactions.name: OracleDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction type deletes an Oracle instance

transactions.name: LedgerStateFix
transactions.doc: This transaction type fixes a problem in the ledger state

transactions.name: MPTokenIssuanceCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates a MPTokensIssuance instance

transactions.name: MPTokenIssuanceDestroy
transactions.doc: This transaction type destroys a MPTokensIssuance instance

transactions.name: MPTokenIssuanceSet
transactions.doc: This transaction type sets flags on a MPTokensIssuance or MPToken instance

transactions.name: MPTokenAuthorize
transactions.doc: This transaction type authorizes a MPToken instance

transactions.name: CredentialCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction type create an Credential instance

transactions.name: CredentialAccept
transactions.doc: This transaction type accept an Credential object

transactions.name: CredentialDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction type delete an Credential object

transactions.name: NFTokenModify
transactions.doc: This transaction type modify a NFToken

transactions.name: PermissionedDomainSet
transactions.doc: This transaction type creates or modifies a Permissioned Domain

transactions.name: PermissionedDomainDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction type deletes a Permissioned Domain

transactions.name: DelegateSet
transactions.doc: This transaction type delegates authorized account specified permissions

transactions.name: VaultCreate
transactions.doc: This transaction creates a single asset vault.

transactions.name: VaultSet
transactions.doc: This transaction updates a single asset vault.

transactions.name: VaultDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction deletes a single asset vault.

transactions.name: VaultDeposit
transactions.doc: This transaction trades assets for shares with a vault.

transactions.name: VaultWithdraw
transactions.doc: This transaction trades shares for assets with a vault.

transactions.name: VaultClawback
transactions.doc: This transaction claws back tokens from a vault.

transactions.name: Batch
transactions.doc: This transaction type batches together transactions.

transactions.name: LoanBrokerSet
transactions.doc: This transaction creates and updates a Loan Broker

transactions.name: LoanBrokerDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction deletes a Loan Broker

transactions.name: LoanBrokerCoverDeposit
transactions.doc: This transaction deposits First Loss Capital into a Loan Broker

transactions.name: LoanBrokerCoverWithdraw
transactions.doc: This transaction withdraws First Loss Capital from a Loan Broker

transactions.name: LoanBrokerCoverClawback
transactions.doc: This transaction claws back First Loss Capital from a Loan Broker to the issuer of the capital

transactions.name: LoanSet
transactions.doc: This transaction creates a Loan

transactions.name: LoanDelete
transactions.doc: This transaction deletes an existing Loan

transactions.name: LoanManage
transactions.doc: This transaction is used to change the delinquency status of an existing Loan

transactions.name: LoanPay
transactions.doc: The Borrower uses this transaction to make a Payment on the Loan.

transactions.name: ConfidentialMPTConvert
transactions.doc: This transaction type converts into confidential MPT balance.

transactions.name: ConfidentialMPTMergeInbox
transactions.doc: This transaction type merges MPT inbox.

transactions.name: ConfidentialMPTConvertBack
transactions.doc: This transaction type converts back into public MPT balance.

transactions.name: SponsorshipTransfer
transactions.doc: This transaction transfers sponsorship on an object/account.

transactions.name: SponsorshipSet
transactions.doc: This transaction creates a Sponsorship object.

transactions.name: EnableAmendment
transactions.doc: This system-generated transaction type is used to update the status of the various amendments. For details, see: https://xrpl.org/amendments.html

transactions.name: SetFee
transactions.doc: This system-generated transaction type is used to update the network's fee settings. For details, see: https://xrpl.org/fee-voting.html

transactions.name: UNLModify
transactions.doc: This system-generated transaction type is used to update the network's negative UNL For details, see: https://xrpl.org/negative-unl.html

universal.name: tfFullyCanonicalSig
universal.doc: Requires a fully canonical signature (obsolete, always implicit since RequireFullyCanonicalSig).

universal.name: tfInnerBatchTxn
universal.doc: Marks a transaction as an inner transaction of a Batch.

AccountRoot.name: lsfPasswordSpent
AccountRoot.doc: True, if password set fee is spent.

AccountRoot.name: lsfRequireDestTag
AccountRoot.doc: True, to require a DestinationTag for payments.

AccountRoot.name: lsfRequireAuth
AccountRoot.doc: True, to require a authorization to hold IOUs.

AccountRoot.name: lsfDisallowXRP
AccountRoot.doc: True, to disallow sending XRP.

AccountRoot.name: lsfDisableMaster
AccountRoot.doc: True, force regular key

AccountRoot.name: lsfNoFreeze
AccountRoot.doc: True, cannot freeze ripple states

AccountRoot.name: lsfGlobalFreeze
AccountRoot.doc: True, all assets frozen

AccountRoot.name: lsfDefaultRipple
AccountRoot.doc: True, incoming trust lines allow rippling by default

AccountRoot.name: lsfDepositAuth
AccountRoot.doc: True, all deposits require authorization

AccountRoot.name: lsfDisallowIncomingNFTokenOffer
AccountRoot.doc: True, reject new incoming NFT offers

AccountRoot.name: lsfDisallowIncomingCheck
AccountRoot.doc: True, reject new checks

AccountRoot.name: lsfDisallowIncomingPayChan
AccountRoot.doc: True, reject new paychans

AccountRoot.name: lsfDisallowIncomingTrustline
AccountRoot.doc: True, reject new trustlines (only if no issued assets)

AccountRoot.name: lsfAllowTrustLineLocking
AccountRoot.doc: True, enable trustline locking

AccountRoot.name: lsfSell
AccountRoot.doc: True, offer was placed as a sell.

AccountRoot.name: lsfLowReserve
AccountRoot.doc: True, if entry counts toward reserve.

AccountRoot.name: lsfLowFreeze
AccountRoot.doc: True, low side has set freeze flag

AccountRoot.name: lsfHighFreeze
AccountRoot.doc: True, high side has set freeze flag

AccountRoot.name: lsfAMMNode
AccountRoot.doc: True, trust line to AMM.

AccountRoot.name: lsfLowDeepFreeze
AccountRoot.doc: True, low side has set deep freeze flag

ledgerEntries.name: NFTokenOffer
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which identifies an offer to buy or sell an NFT. \sa keylet::nftokenOffer

ledgerEntries.name: Check
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which describes a check. \sa keylet::check

ledgerEntries.name: DID
ledgerEntries.doc: The ledger object which tracks the DID. \sa keylet::did

ledgerEntries.name: NegativeUNL
ledgerEntries.doc: The ledger object which tracks the current negative UNL state. \note This is a singleton: only one such object exists in the ledger. \sa keylet::negativeUNL

ledgerEntries.name: NFTokenPage
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which contains a list of NFTs \sa keylet::nftokenPageMin, keylet::nftokenPageMax, keylet::nftokenPage

ledgerEntries.name: SignerList
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which contains a signer list for an account. \sa keylet::signerList

ledgerEntries.name: Ticket
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which describes a ticket. \sa keylet::ticket

ledgerEntries.name: AccountRoot
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which describes an account. \sa keylet::account

ledgerEntries.name: DirectoryNode
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which contains a list of object identifiers. \sa keylet::page, keylet::quality, keylet::book, keylet::next and keylet::ownerDir

ledgerEntries.name: Amendments
ledgerEntries.doc: The ledger object which lists details about amendments on the network. \note This is a singleton: only one such object exists in the ledger. \sa keylet::amendments

ledgerEntries.name: LedgerHashes
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object that contains a list of ledger hashes. This type is used to store the ledger hashes which the protocol uses to implement skip lists that allow for efficient backwards (and, in theory, forward) forward iteration across large ledger ranges. \sa keylet::skip

ledgerEntries.name: Bridge
ledgerEntries.doc: The ledger object which lists details about sidechains. \sa keylet::bridge

ledgerEntries.name: Offer
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which describes an offer on the DEX. \sa keylet::offer

ledgerEntries.name: DepositPreauth
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which describes a deposit pre-authorization. \sa keylet::depositPreauth

ledgerEntries.name: XChainOwnedClaimID
ledgerEntries.doc: A claim id for a cross chain transaction. \sa keylet::xChainClaimID

ledgerEntries.name: RippleState
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which describes a bidirectional trust line. @note Per Vinnie Falco this should be renamed to ltTRUST_LINE \sa keylet::trustLine

ledgerEntries.name: FeeSettings
ledgerEntries.doc: The ledger object which lists the network's fee settings. \note This is a singleton: only one such object exists in the ledger. \sa keylet::feeSettings

ledgerEntries.name: XChainOwnedCreateAccountClaimID
ledgerEntries.doc: A claim id for a cross chain create account transaction. \sa keylet::xChainCreateAccountClaimID

ledgerEntries.name: Escrow
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object describing a single escrow. \sa keylet::escrow

ledgerEntries.name: PayChannel
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object describing a single unidirectional XRP payment channel. \sa keylet::payChannel

ledgerEntries.name: AMM
ledgerEntries.doc: The ledger object which tracks the AMM. \sa keylet::amm

ledgerEntries.name: MPTokenIssuance
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which tracks MPTokenIssuance \sa keylet::mptokenIssuance

ledgerEntries.name: MPToken
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which tracks MPToken \sa keylet::mptoken

ledgerEntries.name: Oracle
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which tracks Oracle \sa keylet::oracle

ledgerEntries.name: Credential
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which tracks Credential \sa keylet::credential

ledgerEntries.name: PermissionedDomain
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object which tracks PermissionedDomain \sa keylet::permissionedDomain

ledgerEntries.name: Delegate
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object representing permissions an account has delegated to another account. \sa keylet::delegate

ledgerEntries.name: Vault
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object representing a single asset vault. \sa keylet::vault

ledgerEntries.name: LoanBroker
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object representing a loan broker \sa keylet::loanBroker

ledgerEntries.name: Loan
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object representing a loan between a Borrower and a Loan Broker \sa keylet::loan

ledgerEntries.name: Sponsorship
ledgerEntries.doc: A ledger object representing a sponsorship. \sa keylet::sponsorship

permissions.name: TrustlineAuthorize
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to authorize a trustline.

permissions.name: TrustlineFreeze
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to freeze a trustline.

permissions.name: TrustlineUnfreeze
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to unfreeze a trustline.

permissions.name: AccountDomainSet
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to set Domain.

permissions.name: AccountEmailHashSet
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to set EmailHash.

permissions.name: AccountMessageKeySet
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to set MessageKey.

permissions.name: AccountTransferRateSet
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to set TransferRate.

permissions.name: AccountTickSizeSet
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to set TickSize.

permissions.name: PaymentMint
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to mint payment (sending account is the issuer). Cross-currency payments are disallowed.

permissions.name: PaymentBurn
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to burn payment (destination account is the issuer). Cross-currency payments are disallowed.

permissions.name: MPTokenIssuanceLock
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to lock an MPToken.

permissions.name: MPTokenIssuanceUnlock
permissions.doc: Grants the ability to unlock an MPToken.
